definitions.scope: campaigns with 1,000 or more contestants and plausible dates; ordinary excludes finance_crypto organizers and the crypto, ambiguous and purchase-opportunity segments from the earlier classification where a campaign was in it
definitions.prize_category: rules in analyze.classify_prize on the prize name
definitions.usd_value: stated value times quantity, converted with Frankfurter rates when the currency is not USD, capped at ten million
definitions.holiday: named holiday in the campaign or incentive name (holidays.py regex); public_holiday_within_3 is a Nager.Date public holiday in the organizer's country within three days of the start
definitions.winners: prize quantity is the number of winners of that prize row; usd_per_winner is the stated value of one unit converted to USD
definitions.launch: launch_kind from wording in the campaign name, incentive name and description; release dates come from Spotify pre-save actions (config_release_date) and Steam store release dates for games in play actions, lead is campaign start minus release, negative means the campaign started before release
definitions.impression_curve_by_duration: median share of a campaign's impressions landing on each day since start, for campaigns of about 7, 14 and 30 days
